risk_description: Simplification could omit necessary safeguards or create inconsistent verification practice
Mobile services may miss hard-to-reach groups if outreach routes are poorly designed
Digital redesign may worsen access for users without devices connectivity or digital literacy
Outreach may inadvertently reveal eligibility status or increase stigma
Tenants may fear retaliation if navigation pathways are not confidential and trusted
Renewal redesign may still impose stress or documentation requirements on disabled people
Grant access may favor organized applicants unless support reaches under-resourced communities
Compliance assistance may benefit already-connected firms more than informal or marginalized businesses
Automatic enrollment may create notice appeal or consent issues if governance is weak
Plain-language simplification may remove legally necessary nuance if review is weak
